antenna.look: a tall radio ANTENNA: a slim grey metal lattice mast with guy-wires and a small dish/whip near the top.

cactus_barrel.look: a round BARREL CACTUS: a squat ribbed green barrel-shaped cactus with a ring of small pink flowers on top and stiff spines.

cactus_prickly.look: a PRICKLY PEAR cactus: clusters of flat oval green paddles with spines and a couple of red fruit.

cactus_saguaro.look: a tall SAGUARO cactus: a thick ribbed green column with two upraised arms, small spines, maybe a white flower on top.

cow_skull.look: a bleached white COW SKULL resting on the sand, two curved horns, empty eye sockets.

dead_bush.look: a DEAD BUSH: a leafless tangle of brittle grey-brown twigs.

hand_pump.look: an old cast-iron HAND PUMP for water: a stout spout and a long lever handle on a small base.

neon_sign.look: a glowing NEON SIGN on a post: the word 'INN' in bright pink-and-blue glowing neon tubing.

radar_dish.look: a RADAR DISH: a white parabolic dish on a swivel mount, angled up at the sky.

sandstone_formation.look: a SANDSTONE ROCK FORMATION: a stack of weathered wind-carved tan rock layers.

sign_inn.look: a rustic wooden INN SIGN: a hanging board on a post showing a bed/mug symbol, weathered desert wood.

sign_weather.look: a metal WEATHER STATION SIGN: a standing sign with a sun/cloud symbol and an arrow.

tumbleweed.look: a round dry TUMBLEWEED: a loose tangled ball of dry brown twigs and branches.

water_bucket.look: a wooden BUCKET full of water, metal handle, water surface visible at the rim.

weather_console.look: a WEATHER CONSOLE: a desk-height cabinet bank of small green monitor screens, dials and switches.

windmill.look: a modern WINDMILL: a tall slender white tubular tower on a square base with a three-blade rotor and nacelle at the very top.

windmill_tall.look: a tall modern WINDMILL: an extra-tall white tubular tower with a three-blade rotor at the top, taller than a normal windmill.
